# netcup_clouddns_records (Data Source)

The records of a revision of a domain on CloudDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_records" "active" {
  domain_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain.

### Optional

- `revision_id` (String) Identifier of the revision. Defaults to the active one.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Records of the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the record.
- `immutable` (Boolean) The `immutable` value of the netcup API.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone.
- `rdata` (String) Record data in zone file format.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, if the record has one.
- `type` (String) Record type.
